name: Facet
text: Choose a dark theme with a high-contrast light toggle for Excava’s interface. Dark themes reduce eye strain in low-light settings and align with competitive dashboards like Manus and Graphify, reinforcing brand consistency. The light toggle ensures accessibility for users who prefer bright interfaces or need to share screens in meetings. Trade-off: dark themes can reduce battery life on OLED screens, but the toggle mitigates this by letting users switch when needed.

name: Pane
text: Dark themes with a light toggle don’t solve glare—users with astigmatism or color vision deficiency still struggle to read low-contrast elements. A better alternative is a single, high-contrast theme with adjustable font sizes and spacing, which improves readability for all users without adding a toggle that risks being overlooked. Settle this by testing both designs with users who have visual impairments and measuring task completion time.
